role: next-word suggestions and word completion after any number of typed letters, plus byte-level scoring
architecture: Minimal Inference Cellular Automaton with learned integer rewrite rules, quantized integer readout, an integer byte-memory sidecar (64-byte window), and integer word readouts over the 240 cellular probes at the current position and at the starts of the previous 2 words, plus 16 MICA rule ticks per word readout (32 pages x 256 candidates, six +-1 scoring terms, VSET of six learned integers) whose terms read a fixed 16-value code of each of the previous three words (a hash of the word) and the current probes
training: automaton, byte readout and memory unchanged from v0.3.5 (E_swa, weight-averaged); word readouts and rule-tick immediates fitted jointly with the rule selection fixed, on the exact integer probe states of 697,070 train-only records (R2 119,823, r3add 179,404, r4add 397,843)
selection: dev2 word prompts 1-600 per domain; pre-declared pass marks confirmed on held-back dev2 prompts 601+; candidate choice by results/CHOICE_RULE.txt; never the clean sets
confirmation: held-back dev2 word prompts; after the choice, 1,920 older development prompts that no choice used (chat dev1000, everyday dev_fresh1000); clean chat/everyday val1000 word benchmark for reporting only
